rated_messages.input_message: What can you do right now to break the automatic habit of smoking to help you feel better? Pause. Close your eyes. And take 10 slow breaths.
Picture the people or things you care deeply about. On a scale of 0-10, how willing are you to let this urge pass for those reasons?
You cant always control when you will see other people smoking. But you can control how you respond to your urge when you do.
To help get through a 'risky situation', remind yourself of how far you've come and the effort that you've put in. Don't ruin your hard work - stay strong!
Try chewing gum if you have trouble resisting smoking when other people light up around you.
Even though you are stressed, are you willing to sit with this urge until it passes if will help you break this habit?
Practice staying in this location without smoking. Just notice your urge. Practicing this will weaken this trigger with time. Just think of it as practice.
Just because letting an urge pass isn't easy, doesn't mean that you can't do it. Try it, you might surprise yourself.
Sometimes an urge comes on like a wave. Imagine what it is like to ride the wave as it ebbs and flows. Instead of trying to swim against it, try riding it out until it disappears into the sea.

Think about what is really important to you. Maybe it's spending time with family or a friend, exercising, doing something spiritual, or creating something. Whatever it is, take a step in that direction.
